text: Current year losses should not be more than ZERO if return is filed under 139(4)

text: Deduction u/s 80G shall be claimed against valid Donee PANs only.
finding: 80G donee PAN mandatory (A648), not assessee's (A12), unique (A645); DB validity external

text: It is mandatory to file Form 29C- Report under section 115JC of the Income-tax Act, 1961 if AMT tax is more than Normal Tax if not opting for New Tax Regime
finding: Form 29C AMT notice compares base 115JC tax vs gross normal (with cess) - mismatched basis, may under-fire

finding: No advisory tying Chapter VI-A Part C deductions to on-time 139(1) filing

text: Deduction u/s 10AA shall be allowed only if return is filed within due date allowed u/s 139(1)
finding: No check that 10AA deduction requires return filed within 139(1) due date
